title: 🎊 R-1 mini optimization and productionizing
text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/41c4a78a1c878105af45c7991e8054c3 as of 2026-11-20T01:26:42.435Z: {"Category":"fast-inference","Last edited":"2026-11-19T10:49:03.077Z","Name":"R-1 mini optimization and productionizing","Priority":"p1","Status":"In progress","date:Period:is_datetime":0,"date:Period:start":"2026-11-17","url":"https://app.notion.com/p/41c4a78a1c878105af45c7991e8054c3"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🎊"} # Plan - RL 299 on B200 - Prod pick: move prod to 20261117 / b200-n128, once the evalkit judge, a wide set and a day of autoeval pass - RL 299 on H100 and H200 (AU's engine) - AU pick: move prod_au to 20261117-h100-int8, once the evalkit judge passes - RL 299 on A100 80GB - [#15276](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15276): add RL 299 as 20261117-a100-int8 - RL 299 on B300 - Profile PR: add 20261117-b300-nvfp4 with its perf table (PR not open) - Roofline for every chip (plan, awaiting Jean's stamp; asked on #15276: "this is the most we can get from the gpu? do we have a roofline graph?", "We should do that for all chips") - Today: a measured roofline graph exists for one chip, B200 on the 1028 package (workstreams/2026/11/10/fpp_2b_b200_roofline, the run that found prefill cadence, +20%). A100, H100, H200, B300 and L40S have none. ROOFLINE.md in the RL 299 workstream is a plain-decode bound for B200, H100 and L40S; it leaves out the vision tower, prefill and DFlash, and vision attention alone was 32 to 37% of GPU time on the B200, so it cannot answer the question. - Step 1, measured roofline per chip: one Modal dev sandbox per chip on the profile's registry flags. AIPerf at the gate level and at the peak (rep-1k, 180 s each) with GPU busy %, power and clock sampled, then a torch-profiler window at the gate level. Reuses the B200 workstream's launch.py and analyze.py, made chip-generic. Per chip: the roofline graph (each kernel's TFLOP/s at its FLOPs per byte against the chip's compute and HBM roofs), GPU time share per kernel group, % of roof per group. - Step 2, one summary graph and table: per chip, pages/s at the gate, GPU busy %, the state (GPU-bound, host-bound, power-capped) and the largest gap with the lever it points at. That is the answer to "is this the most we can get" for each chip. - Step 3, one PR as Devin: workstream workstreams/2026/11/18/r1_mini_roofline (README, RESULTS, scripts, graphs) and a Roofline line per variant in r1_mini.md linking its graph. No registry, pick or deploy change. Levers the graphs point at come back as a separate plan. - Chips and profiles: A100 80GB 20261117-a100-int8 first (the question was asked there; it flattens at 4.0 to 4.4 pages/s from 16 to 128 in flight), then B200 b200-n128, H100 and H200 20261117-h100-int8, L40S l40s-1112 (1028 weights, the Marketplace chip), B300 20261117-b300-nvfp4 once its profile exists. Not Inf2 or TPU v6e: no GPU roofline applies. - Cost: about 0.75 GPU-hour a chip, about 4.5 GPU-hours, about \$20 on Modal dev. No prod. # Logs PR states read Nov 18, 12:52 PT. ✅ is merged. The rl299 shadow is deployed to Modal dev, and prod release v1.12.24-715 carries the #15274 merge. No prod or AU pick has changed. Every judge number is from the workstream's 05-gates judge; evalkit's pinned judge has not run on RL 299 and runs before any pick. - RL 299 on B200 (20261117, Modal dev shadow rl299): - [#15274](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15274) ✅ Nov 18, 11:12 PT + Deploy (Nov 18, 11:46 PT, Modal dev shadow fpp-flash-rl299, from main, Jean's go via Xavier). It answered a warm-up page. - Prod release v1.12.24-715 carries the merge; its rollout finished Nov 18, 12:05 PT. No pick changed. - autoeval-replay cron redeployed Nov 18, 12:23 PT, the last of #15274's three deploy steps. - 32.2 pages/s at 128 in flight, \$0.054 per 1k pages. - Judge against BF16: net -3 on rep-1k (floor -30), net -23 on public 2k (floor -60). - Load came from the 05-gates harness, not the shared AIPerf runner. - [#15317](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15317) ✅ Nov 18, 12:28 PT. Tables only, nothing to deploy: the same table from the shared AIPerf runner. 31.31 pages/s at 128 in flight, \$0.055 per 1k pages; p90 stays under 10 s through 128 in flight. - [#15324](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15324) ✅ Nov 18, 12:46 PT + Deploy (Nov 18, 12:26 PT, Modal dev, from its branch, Jean's go): the hourly dev cron autoeval-dev-floors keeps fpp-flash-rl299 warm instead of fpp-flash-b200-route. The auto_route leg on fpp-flash-b200-route now starts cold, which Jean accepted. - Open: against the 1028 package, p99 at 16 and 32 in flight is 1.20 to 1.30 times, so the strict A/B rule fails. Cause not found. - Nov 18, 10:14 PT, [Slack](slackMessage://reductoai.slack.com/C0C8Y03DC3G/1795025644.667359/1795025644.667359): the team wants to ship the new checkpoint. RL 299 has no autoeval day or wide set yet. - RL 299 on H100 and H200 (20261117-h100-int8, AU's engine): - [#15275](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15275) ✅ Nov 18, 12:49 PT. Not in a prod release yet: v1.12.24-724 was cut before it. Its release redeploys fpp-flash with the same images. - H100: 12.94 pages/s at 32 in flight, \$0.085 per 1k pages. Judge against RL 299 on B200: net -3 (bound -30). - prod_au stays on 20260928 / h100-int8. - [#15245](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15245), the 1028 version, closed unmerged Nov 17, 21:11 PT (Jean: RL 299 only). - Full log: R-1 mini RL 299 as INT8 on H100 (AU) - RL 299 on A100 80GB (20261117-a100-int8, dev host only): - [#15276](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15276) open, renamed from a100-1112, CI green on 7ba4925329. Conflicts with main since #15275 merged. - No longer builds on #15223: the 1028 a100-int8 host and recipe are out of it. The variant targets 16 in flight, to match the gate. - Roofline (Nov 18, one Modal dev pod, [#15342](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15342)): saturated at 16 in flight, with headroom in the kernels. A GPU kernel runs 99% of the profiler window (PCIe pod, 3.16 pages/s, 295 of 300 W), and the kernels with recorded shapes (50% of kernel time) run at 52% of their roof; at the roof, about 4.1 pages/s (+30%). Replaces the first graph, whose window was at 1 in flight. ![A100 80GB roofline](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjpudWxsLCJidWNrZXRfbmFtZSI6ImRldmluYXR0YWNobWVudHMiLCJidWNrZXRfa2V5IjoiYXR0YWNobWVudHNfcHJpdmF0ZS9vcmdfUWxrcUZvbVlaWENvTVVBTS85NjQyNmJlNy04NjNkLTQzMjYtYjBkNS0wN2FlN2RkZjRmNmUiLCJpYXQiOjE3OTUwNDc2ODIsIm9yZ19pZCI6Im9yZ19RbGtxRm9tWVpYQ29NVUFNIiwiZmlsZW5hbWUiOiJyb29mbGluZV9hMTAwLnBuZyJ9.v3sDdKpwFNMA-Fda1lrG0hKnnsNWFQa2HQEznAwpWIo) \- Lever 1, vision attention on INT8 tensor cores (lossy, needs the judge gate): 34% of kernel time at 161 TFLOP/s; the BF16 roof is 312, the INT8 roof 624.
- Lever 2, INT8 vision linears (tiles, epilogues): 7.7% of kernel time at 36 to 46% of roof; the language model's INT8 GEMMs run at 51 to 68%.
- Lever 3, fewer vision tokens per page (lossy, needs Jean's approval): vision attention FLOPs grow with tokens squared. - RL 299 on B300: - Started Nov 18, 12:23 PT, at Jean's ask. The variant will be 20261117-b300-nvfp4. No PR yet, nothing merged or deployed. - 1028 on A100 80GB (a100-int8, dev host only): - [#15223](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15223) closed unmerged Nov 18, 12:03 PT (RL 299 replaces 1028). Not deployed. - Earlier log: R-1 mini on A100 - 1028 on other hardware: closed unmerged Nov 18, 11:35 PT (Jean: RL 299 replaces 1028). None was deployed. - [#15240](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15240): B300 tables for b200-n128 and b200-b300-128 - [#15239](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15239): L4 as l4-1112 - [#15246](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15246): A100 40GB as a100-int8 with 20 seats - [#15231](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15231): A10G as a10g-int8 - [#15247](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15247): Inferentia2 as inf2-1028. Marketplace picks stay on 20260928. - [#15229](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15229): TPU v6e INT8 latency columns and judge result in the README ## Impact - B300 vs B200, back to back: 21.4 vs 32.2 pages/s per container (B300 range 21.4 to 31.0). Measured on dev, 2026-11-18 (Jensen). - B300 FP8 vision attention ([#15385](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15385), 20261117-b300-fp8attn vs 20261117-b300-nvfp4, back to back on one dev B300, AIPerf rep-1k): AMD hosts +6.2% to +9.7% at 64 in flight and +9.2% to +11.8% at 128 (30.0 to 30.8 → 33.2 to 34.0 pages/s); Intel host +3.3% and +4.5% at 128, +6.9% and -1.4% at 64. Measured on dev, 2026-11-19. - B300 package: 28 pages/s at 128 in flight, about 10% under B200. Measured on dev, 2026-11-18. - A100 roofline: 99% busy at 16 in flight; slow kernels leave about 30%. All-chip kernels at 32 to 73% of roof. Measured 2026-11-18. - GPU cost per 1k pages at saturation, dev, one container: RL 299 on B200 \$0.055 at 128 in flight (31.31 pages/s); on H100 INT8 \$0.085 at 32 in flight (12.94 pages/s). - Quality, RL 299 against BF16: judge net -3 on rep-1k (floor -30) and -23 on public 2k (floor -60). - p99, RL 299 against the 1028 package: 1.20 to 1.30 times at 16 and 32 in flight. Cause not found. - Prod: no prod or AU pick has changed, so prod GPU cost per 1k pages, p99 and utilization are not measured yet; measure before vs after each pick change. Today R-1 mini costs 4.79 USD per 1k pages across regions (11-09 to 11-17), and 1.55 on 11-17 at 1.48M pages.
